about.title: About me
about.lead: I started with the foundation: computer assembly and maintenance, networks and a lot of development in my Technical Degree in Internet Computing.
about.body1: Since finishing the technical course, I practice HTML5, CSS3 and ES6+ JavaScript. The IT routine at BAAN, solving real users' problems, taught me to design for the people who use things and helped me become the developer I am today.
about.body2: In practice, I learned SEO and I build high-conversion landing pages: fast, clear and made to lead people to act.
about.body3: Now my focus is AI Engineering, with Claude. I'm in the 5th term of Software Engineering and building an academic React Native project, Caminu (see Projects).
about.photoAlt: Portrait of Eduardo Dias, wearing round glasses and a black t-shirt, outdoors

emphasis.typescript: Strict typing in everything I write now. Learning to do it right from the start.
emphasis.react: Components and Server Components. Learning to think of interfaces as systems.
emphasis.nextjs: App Router, SEO and performance. It's where landing pages get fast.
emphasis.tailwind: All the visuals, with tokens and zero loose CSS.
emphasis.claude: Claude Code every day, API and Agent SDK in my studies. It's my specialization.

resume.summary: Front-end developer and AI Engineer in training, focused on Claude. Solid foundation in HTML5, CSS3 and ES6+ JavaScript, hands-on SEO and high-conversion landing pages. Five years in technical support taught me to design for the people who use things.
